stable.label: native-fluid-projection-v3-ci-pass
stable.note: The active 3D browser route remains the compiler-proven native material/fluid slice. Native body-to-material coupling V2 and Weather3D-V2-to-volume coupling V1 are promoted on main but isolated from the active browser route. Weather3D V2 remains the authoritative promoted weather route. Runtime browser execution and iPhone device execution remain unverified.

simulated_state: native kinetic energy and signed XYZ momentum
deterministic seeded state evolution including velocity/pressure
render_coupling: 3D solid/water density derives from native occupancy
surface normals derive from native field gradients
sand wetness derives from native moisture
water turbidity derives from native suspended sediment
native pressure is dynamics/telemetry and never relabeled as sediment
water shape derives from simulated occupancy rather than animated geometry

advection moves water at most one neighboring voxel per substep
ray marching interpolates only for presentation
native body v1 is not loaded by the active browser route
Weather3D V2 and the CI-proven world-coupling bridge are separate promoted native candidates not yet loaded by this route

native_body_material_coupling.truth: This is API-only coupling of the authoritative solvers. There is still no buoyancy, drag, pressure-force, added-mass, lift, wake or body-driven fluid displacement, so swimming is not claimed.

causal_model: temperature-dependent saturation condenses humidity into cloud
terrain receives precipitation into surface hydrology/runoff
native resolved fields produce vorticity/tornado diagnostics rather than timer-spawned effects
browser_contract: browser consumes the exact compiler-proven zero-import WebAssembly payload
model version and 96x48x96 dimensions must match
renderer uses WebGPU and reads native atmosphere fields
Math.random is forbidden from generating simulation state
world_weather.truth: This is a deterministic native 3D atmosphere/hydrology model and from-scratch WebGPU presentation, not validated DNS, LES, mesoscale NWP or tornado forecasting. The promoted Weather3D browser route is not yet two-way coupled to the authoritative 3D material/fluid volume; that coupling currently exists only as the separate CI-proven native bridge candidate recorded below.

exchange_unit.truth: This is an explicit deterministic bridge exchange unit, not a claim that the two pre-existing solvers already share calibrated SI water-mass units.

coupling: Weather3D accumulated surface runoff can remove 256 bridge units and create one real WATER voxel in the authoritative material volume
one bounded exposed native WATER voxel can be removed and add 256 units to near-surface Weather3D humidity
native ROCK/SAND solid-column height deterministically feeds Weather3D terrain elevation
directional transfer ledgers measure weather-removed/volume-added and volume-removed/weather-added units
bridge conservation error is zero for the deterministic causal fixtures
fixed native setup plus fixed exchange reproduces the same combined state hash
weather_volume_coupling_v1.truth: This is a standalone native coupling bridge over the two authoritative source kernels. It is not loaded by /genesis-codehood/ or /world-weather/ yet, is not LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED, does not add hydrodynamic body forces, swimming, wakes or body-to-fluid reaction, and does not turn either underlying approximation into validated CFD or NWP.

superseded_world_weather_v1.truth: Preserved historical proof only. It must not be used as the active weather target or as evidence for Weather3D V2 beyond independently shared gates.

native_volume_renderer.truth: WebGPU ray marching is presentation over native 3D state; time-driven fake water-normal animation is forbidden; water normals derive from native water-density gradients and turbidity derives from native suspended sediment, never pressure.

active_objective: Promote the exact CI-proven Weather3D-V2-to-native-volume bridge into one authoritative browser runtime without duplicating either solver, then prove the browser contract reads and advances the same coupled native state.
next_gate: Wire the exact 38,910-byte zero-import coupling WASM payload into a single authoritative runtime path, add fail-closed browser-contract tests for real runoff injection, evaporation feedback and topography feedback, and keep LIVE_TESTED/DEVICE_TESTED false until actual execution evidence exists.
next_scientific_blocker: The native two-way transfer bridge is CI-proven on main, but it is still an isolated candidate. The deployed Weather3D and GENESIS browser routes do not yet execute that combined coupled state, so runtime integration—not another solver—is the next blocker. Deferred hydrodynamic body-force PR #124 must remain parked until this promotion gate is complete.
